title: Chapter 597 - 597 Bad Luck
content:
Chapter 597 - 597 Bad Luck

Chapter 597 - 597 Bad Luck

597 Bad Luck

Hua Nation, Qing City.

At first, Sam did not know what 20 Constitution points meant.

However, the Gilbeven family knew everything.

When they saw that Sam had gained 20 Constitution points, they all shouted excitedly.

“Superman! Sam has also become Superman!”

“God bless us!”

“Thank you, Master!”

“Master isn’t on Earth,” Dean Gilbeven said. “Let’s go thank Grandpa, Grandma, and Aunt!”

Thus, the Gilbevan family went to Lin Fan’s house and called Lin Tao, Dai Weixue, and Lin Xiaoyao, Grandpa, Grandma, and Aunt respectively non-stop.

…

Just as Lin Fan had expected, after Sam obtained 20 points of Constitution, his efficiency in picking up branches had indeed increased.

They had barbecue earlier than usual today.

In the blink of an eye, it was the next day.

The breeze was gentle, and the sky was clear.

Lin Fan, the Heavenly Hound, and Sam stepped onto the road ahead.

Not long after, Lin Fan heard a clear notification in his mind.

[Ding! You’ve spent 312 hours in the Otherworld. You’ve received 300 points of spiritual energy.]

Lin Fan felt his head clear up. He was used to this feeling.

Therefore, he did not reveal a strange expression and continued to move forward unhurriedly.

…

On the other hand…

Augustus came to a forest. There were shrubs, tall trees, and vines… This was a primeval forest.

He sighed as he walked.

“Oh! This tree trunk is so thick!”

“There are also vines. They’re so sturdy! I dare to guarantee that this is definitely comparable to the iron chains on Earth. It’s really hard to imagine how they grew.

“Looking at these vines, I suddenly think of King Kong from the movies!

“Just like this…”

As Augustus spoke, he grabbed a vine and swung forward, directly reaching another vine… He swung from one vine to another, moving forward continuously.

In Nashland’s live broadcast room.

“Look at what our hero Augustus is doing!” the host exclaimed excitedly. “It’s so amazing! He’s simply a real-life version of a superhero!”

YA: [The two vines are so far apart, but Augustus can actually move freely!]

MAKE: [Augustus is indeed a superhero. He’s so handsome!]

Julie: [Augustus, you’re the best. I love you!]

…

Augustus’ popularity increased once again.

McJay: [Hey you guys, look. Isn’t there something in front?]

Carol: [It seems… like it.]

…

In the Otherworld.

In the forest, a large group of birds seemed to be frightened and fled into the distance.

In the next moment…

A giant gorilla that was about five meters tall and the size of a mountain appeared in Augustus’ field of vision.

The gorilla was grabbing the vines and moving forward at an extremely fast speed. It would occasionally let out a loud roar.

Augustus instinctively felt his heart palpitate. He hurriedly turned around and fled into the distance.

However, the gorilla was too fast on the vines.

In just an instant, it had already caught up.

The gorilla reached out with its huge claws and easily grabbed Augustus in its hand as if it was pinching a bug.

Augustus used all his strength to struggle, but it was as if he was being held by an iron hoop. It was useless.

He looked at the gorilla’s sharp teeth.

Terror and fear engulfed his entire body. He was completely soaked in sweat.

His body and even his soul started to tremble.

“Help!

“Someone save me!”

Perhaps Augustus’ call for help had worked.

Not far away, a tall figure, a dog, and a brown-skinned man slowly walked over.

It was Lin Fan, the Heavenly Hound, and Sam!

Augustus thought back to how Lin Fan had killed the Unicorn Rhinoceros not too long ago. It was as if he had seen his savior as he shouted, “Help!

” I’ve been captured. Come and save me.

“Save me.”

He was afraid that Lin Fan did not understand. In the end, he even used very bad Hua language to call out, “Save… Save… me…”

Sam felt the terrifying aura of the gorilla, and his heart palpitated.

He was a little surprised. “Master, it’s that person from yesterday.”

In fact, he was not the only one surprised. Lin Fan was surprised as well.

Lin Fan had already seen the black aura above Augustus’ head yesterday. He knew that Augustus would have a fatal misfortune. However, he did not expect that this misfortune would appear right in front of him.

Lin Fan did not seem to see or hear anything. His footsteps did not slow down or speed up.

Augustus shouted again, “Please, save me!”

Perhaps Augustus’ voice had disturbed the gorilla. It frowned in displeasure.

Then, he clenched his fist.

“Ah!”

The terrifying power broke Augustus’ bones, and his body felt like it was about to explode. The pain was extreme.

Explosion?

That was right!

It was an explosion!

The gorilla exerted force again.

In the next moment, Augustus exploded like a watermelon.

Blood and minced meat flew everywhere.

Then, the gorilla stuffed the remaining flesh in its hand into its mouth.

It was ferocious and terrifying.

Lin Fan’s spiritual energy had long been raised to a terrifying state.

He did not care about this.

Sam’s face turned pale, and he almost vomited.

After the gorilla ate Augustus, it seemed to think that the taste was not bad.

A pair of scarlet eyes landed on Lin Fan and Sam.

A ferocious expression appeared on the gorilla’s dark face.

Then, like a speeding truck, it rushed toward Lin Fan and Sam. It was as if it wanted to knock the two of them away in one go.

As the gorilla ran, the entire forest seemed to jump.

Lin Fan continued walking forward as if he did not see or hear anything.

100 meters.

90 meters.

80 meters.

…

In the blink of an eye, the gorilla was only ten meters away from Lin Fan.

Ten meters seemed very far.

However, one had to know…

The gorilla was five meters tall!

It was not an exaggeration to say that this distance was close.

Lin Fan could even feel the wild wind that the gorilla created as it ran.

Sam was so scared that he collapsed to the ground.

This was not because he was timid, but because it was an instinctive reaction.

At this moment, Lin Fan made his move!

He slowly waved his right hand and pulled out the Star Meteorite Sword.

[Sword 1—draw the sword and slash the sky!]

The dazzling sword light drew a beautiful arc in the air.

The gorilla, which was originally running at high speed, suddenly stopped as if it had braked.

The next moment, the gorilla’s huge body was split into two from the middle.

The two halves of his body fell to the ground like a huge rock, stirring up dust.

Blood spurted out like a fountain!
